note: Provisional only. Census performed against Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md and Plans/Wiring_Matrix.production.json (catalog.* ids) and UCC-* PlanUnits. Disposition per candidate in {reuse_existing, alias, supersede, conflict, new_candidate}. Each candidate carries typed payload, result, error, idempotency/revision, permission, receipt, and recovery semantics. Final canonical IDs adjudicated by the audit agent.

census_source.census_note: No existing catalog.* for formatter.*, commands.custom.*, shortcuts.*, mcp.server.*, skill.*, plugin.*, tool.select_for_turn, lsp.server.add. These are new_candidate. catalog.settings_bloom_open is retired/superseded.

dispositions.evidence: catalog.lsp_restart_server present in UI_Command_Catalog; identical semantics (restart a language server).
dispositions.distinguishes: Settings surface invokes the canonical owner; no new ID minted.
dispositions.idempotency: restarting an already-running server is a no-op restart; revision increments on config change only
dispositions.recovery: on restart_failed: open logs, offer fallback to last-known-good config

dispositions.evidence: No catalog.lsp_server_add; custom LSP registration is a settings mutation (persistent).
dispositions.distinguishes: Persistent registration vs one-shot restart (catalog.lsp_restart_server).
dispositions.idempotency: adding the same (name,language,command) twice is a no-op returning existing id
dispositions.recovery: on invalid_command: validate path/env, offer test-connection probe

dispositions.evidence: LSP exposes formatDocument while Formatters_System also claims per-language ownership; no existing verb resolves the conflict.
dispositions.distinguishes: Designates the effective format owner per language; demotes the loser. Feeds formatter.resolve_conflict.
dispositions.idempotency: re-resolving to the same owner is a no-op
dispositions.recovery: undo restores prior owner; lsp.format_document then routes to the effective owner

dispositions.evidence: No catalog.formatter_* exists; formatter table CRUD is settings-owned.
dispositions.distinguishes: Persistent formatter registration with command/env/ext + per-language ownership claim.
dispositions.idempotency: same (name,languages,command) is a no-op

dispositions.evidence: No existing formatter health probe.
dispositions.distinguishes: One-shot health probe (detected/not_found/disabled) + sample run; NOT a format-document dispatch.
dispositions.idempotency: stateless probe; safe to repeat
dispositions.recovery: not_found: install; non_zero: show stderr + command editor

dispositions.evidence: Single-ownership-per-language requires an explicit resolve verb; no existing catalog id.
dispositions.distinguishes: Persistent ownership mutation; the loser is demoted (not deleted).
dispositions.idempotency: no-op if already sole owner

dispositions.evidence: catalog.lsp_format_document exists AND Formatters_System claims per-language ownership; two owners race without resolution.
dispositions.distinguishes: Resolution flow designates effective owner; if a custom formatter owns the language, formatter wins and lsp.format_document routes to the formatter command. Tracked as a conflict pending canonical adjudication.
dispositions.idempotency: format is deterministic per owner; revision-tagged

dispositions.evidence: No catalog.commands_* custom-command lifecycle exists.
dispositions.distinguishes: Persistent custom-command definition with parameters/includes + shell-safety validation.
dispositions.idempotency: create with same name in same scope returns 409 (no silent overwrite)
dispositions.recovery: shell_safety_violation: highlight offending segment, offer restricted-mode alternative

dispositions.evidence: No existing custom-command update verb.
dispositions.distinguishes: Revision-tagged update; preserves prior revision for undo.
dispositions.idempotency: same patch is a no-op at same revision

dispositions.evidence: No existing delete verb for custom commands.
dispositions.distinguishes: Removes custom command; built-in override is cleared separately.
dispositions.idempotency: deleting twice is a no-op

dispositions.evidence: Existing dry-method default-guard setting is related; the one-shot dry-run preview action is distinct and HARD-GATED to never dispatch to an agent.
dispositions.distinguishes: Validation gate enforces dispatch_target=preview_only and agent_recipient=null; renders a preview receipt only.
dispositions.idempotency: stateless preview; safe to repeat
dispositions.receipt: command_dry_run_receipt (preview only; NEVER an agent dispatch event)

dispositions.evidence: No catalog.shortcuts_* exists.
dispositions.distinguishes: Persistent shortcut binding with conflict detection at capture time.
dispositions.idempotency: rebinding same combo+command is a no-op

dispositions.evidence: No existing remap verb.
dispositions.distinguishes: Moves an existing binding to a new combo; runs conflict detection.
dispositions.idempotency: no-op if same combo

dispositions.evidence: No existing reset verb; extensions.commands.reset-shortcuts is the settings value, not the action.
dispositions.distinguishes: Restores defaults for a scope; revision-tagged.
dispositions.idempotency: reset to defaults is a fixed point

dispositions.evidence: No existing import verb.
dispositions.distinguishes: Imports a shortcut bundle with conflict preview (preview-then-apply).
dispositions.idempotency: re-importing the same bundle is a no-op in merge mode

dispositions.evidence: No existing export verb.
dispositions.distinguishes: Exports current shortcuts (and cheat-sheet) to a portable bundle.
dispositions.idempotency: pure read; stateless

dispositions.evidence: No catalog.mcp_* add exists.
dispositions.distinguishes: Persistent server registration with transport (stdio/remote-url/sse) + auth.
dispositions.idempotency: same (name,transport) is a no-op
dispositions.recovery: auth_required: route to CLI-owned or PM-direct OAuth flow per boundary

dispositions.evidence: catalog.remote_reconnect covers remote reconnect; MCP server reconnect reuses the canonical reconnect family, not a parallel verb.
dispositions.distinguishes: Transport-aware receipt (stdio vs remote-url) + exposed-tools re-probe; lazy-exposure respected.
dispositions.idempotency: reconnecting an ok server is a no-op refresh
dispositions.recovery: failed: AvailabilityReason + retry/deep-link; auth_expired: refresh OAuth

dispositions.evidence: No catalog.mcp_* restart; remote_reconnect is a different verb (reconnect vs restart of a stdio child).
dispositions.distinguishes: One-shot restart of a stdio MCP child process; re-probes tools.
dispositions.idempotency: restart of a running server is a clean restart

dispositions.evidence: No per-kind enable verb; enable is distinct from install (catalog.catalog_install_item).
dispositions.distinguishes: Project-enablement for a skill (a lifecycle transition), not an install.
dispositions.idempotency: enabling an enabled skill is a no-op

dispositions.evidence: Canonical catalog item install verbs exist; per-kind install reuses them with a kind discriminator.
dispositions.distinguishes: kind=skill|plugin|tool param; install is distinct from enable.
dispositions.idempotency: installing same item+version is a no-op
dispositions.recovery: incompatible: pin prior version; untrusted: trust-prompt

dispositions.evidence: No per-kind enable verb; plugin enable is distinct (hook registration, tool-override activation).
dispositions.distinguishes: Activates a plugin's hooks + optional tool-override; distinct lifecycle from skill enable.
dispositions.idempotency: no-op if already enabled

dispositions.evidence: No per-kind enable verb; tool enable maps to the project-enabled rung of the 5-state ladder.
dispositions.distinguishes: Enables a tool for the project (rung 2 of 5); does NOT imply currently-available or selected.
dispositions.idempotency: no-op if already project-enabled

dispositions.evidence: No existing verb for the selected-for-turn rung (4 of 5).
dispositions.distinguishes: Transient per-turn selection; idempotent within a turn; does NOT invoke.
dispositions.idempotency: selecting twice in the same turn is a no-op

dispositions.evidence: Canonical capability policy verb exists; per-capability Auto/On/Off grid reuses it with a capability param.
dispositions.distinguishes: Tri-state value + capability key; do NOT mint a per-capability verb.
dispositions.idempotency: no-op if same value
dispositions.recovery: unavailable capability: surface AvailabilityReason; Auto resolves to off

dispositions.evidence: Bloom open is the legacy category-modal verb; Stack expands a destination in place (different motion + state).
dispositions.distinguishes: Targets a destination_id + expand; bloom.open targeted a modal chip. Retire bloom; alias only if external deeplink requires it.
dispositions.idempotency: opening an already-expanded destination focuses the subcategory
dispositions.recovery: unknown_destination: fall back to stack top + search

dispositions.evidence: No existing expand/collapse-all for the stack model.
dispositions.distinguishes: expand toggles one destination in place; collapse_all returns to stack top (UI session state).
dispositions.idempotency: toggle is idempotent to target state

dispositions.evidence: Canonical file/terminal/editor verbs exist; Stack's inline File Manager + Terminal surfaces reuse them.
dispositions.distinguishes: Navigation/embedding verbs reused; only the host surface is new.
dispositions.idempotency: opening an open resource focuses it

retire_or_alias.reason: Old chip/bloom category-modal architecture; Stack expands destinations in place.
retire_or_alias.compatibility_alias: cmd.settings.manager.open (only if external deeplinks still resolve bloom ids)

retire_or_alias.reason: Binary regular/yolo is unsafe and stale; replaced by explicit Freedom-level (safe/normal/unrestricted) + shell-safety gate.

preserve_or_reuse_note: Provider/account/model/usage/auth/installation actions are owned by core (concept-03 demonstrates) and are NOT duplicated here. Provider install/update/verify reuse the existing provider/onboarding verbs; catalog item install/update/remove reuse catalog.* verbs with a kind discriminator. No SQLite; no Playwright terminology.
